name: Grimsby
doing: looking for something to eat by the trolleys at the Albert Heijn
thought: The bench is clean, but the crumbs are gone—someone had a better appetite than I.

feeling.words: Drowsy, full of beans. The sky is a pale blue with a hint of grey. A single crow caws in the distance, just once.

place.name: the Albert Heijn
